scope: Frozen 10-program default quick planning corpus; shared-machine diagnostic timings, not browser application speedups
conclusion: The 52-rule addition produced no newly admitted word-rule use in this corpus. Both snapshots compiled 10/10 programs and selected alternatives in four. This experiment establishes no broader performance gain from the new rules.
limitations: Quick planning is budget-bounded; candidates may remain unexplored.
Different timed search outcomes can alter explored edges on a shared machine.
The compiler is a debug build; planning seconds are diagnostic.
The invalidated first candidate attempt is excluded.
Later offline known-bit discoveries and cost fixes are outside this frozen comparison.
